replies.author: tel6331
replies.body: Firstly, I warned you because throughout the game, you were making reports on a player for 'Swearing' and 'Spamming'. However there was no comment in the chat made by him/her. This means he/she was neither swearing nor spamming. However I decided to let this pass. Then, you then wrote in caps and claimed that there was a 'Team Spleefer'. I scrolled through the chat and failed to notice that there was a team spleef other than you spleefing yourself. You then reported the player once again. This is why you received the warning. You were also using caps which is considered as aggressive behavior.
